title: 第21章 巫师与超凡第22章 巫师语
slug: 巫师让你学知识你杀穿万界
lines: 伊森愣了一下。
“......还真是自习啊？”
他目光扫向四周，那些同样坐着的新生，有的脸上带着和他一样的困惑，有的一副习以为常的模样，还有几个明显早就知道，已经坐直身体，盯着桌面。
光芒从桌面升起。
那淡蓝色的光芒在半空中凝聚、扩散，最后形成一个约莫两米见方的光幕，悬浮在每个人面前。
光幕上，一行行文字逐一亮起：
【巫师与超凡】
【第一课：何为巫师，何为超凡】
【本课程为免费公开课，仅此一节。课后无答疑，无重复，无补课。】
【课程结束后，光幕自动消失。】
【现在开始。】
文字消失，光幕中央浮现出一个画面。
那是一片浩瀚的星空，无数星辰点缀在漆黑的背景上，缓慢旋转。
一个声音响起，和之前那个机械般的声音不同，这次是一个温和的男声，带着某种安抚人心的力量：
“凡人仰望星空，看到的是神秘，是敬畏，是未知。”
画面变化，星空消失，取而代之的是一个站在山巅的黑色身影。
那身影背对画面，看不清面目，只能看见他负手而立，面对着一轮巨大的血色月亮。
“巫师仰望星空，看到的是规则，是真理，是道路。”
黑色身影抬起右手，轻轻一点。
那轮血月骤然破碎，化作无数细碎的光点，消散在夜空中。
画面再变。
一座繁华的城市出现在光幕中，街道上人来人往，孩童追逐嬉戏，商贩高声叫卖。
“凡人生活在世界表面，看到的是一日三餐，生老病死，悲欢离合。”
视角上升，越过城墙，越过田野，越过森林，最终停在一座高塔前。
那高塔通体漆黑，塔身表面有无数符文流转，顶端悬浮着一团幽绿的火焰。
“巫师生活在世界深处，看到的是能量流动，规则交织，真理碎片。”
画面切入高塔内部。
一个穿着灰色袍子的人坐在实验室里，面前摆满了瓶瓶罐罐，各种颜色的液体在玻璃器皿中翻滚、沸腾、变色。
他手中握着一根细长的玻璃棒，轻轻搅拌着某团散发着微光的液体，神情专注得近乎痴迷。
“巫师是什么？”
声音停顿了一瞬。
“巫师是探索者。探索世界的本质，探索能量的规律，探索规则的边界。”
画面中的灰袍人放下玻璃棒，拿起一支装满银色液体的试管，小心翼翼滴入面前的烧杯中。
content_en:
Ethan was stunned for a moment.
"...Is this really self-study?"
He glanced around and saw the freshmen who were also sitting. Some had the same confusion on their faces as him, some looked accustomed to it, and a few had obviously known about it for a long time and had already sat upright and stared at the table.
Light rises from the table.
The light blue light condensed and spread in mid-air, and finally formed a light curtain about two meters square, suspended in front of everyone.
On the light screen, lines of text lit up one by one:
【Wizards and Supernatural】
[Lesson 1: What is a wizard and what is extraordinary]
[This course is a free public course, this is the only section. No Q&A, no repetition, and no make-up lessons after class. 】
[After the course ends, the light curtain disappears automatically. 】
【Start now. 】
The text disappeared, and a picture appeared in the center of the light curtain.
It was a vast starry sky, with countless stars dotted on the dark background, slowly rotating.
A voice sounded. Different from the mechanical voice before, this time it was a gentle male voice, with some kind of soothing power:
"Mortals look up at the stars and see mystery, awe, and the unknown."
The picture changed, and the starry sky disappeared, replaced by a black figure standing on the top of the mountain.
The figure has his back to the screen, and his face cannot be seen clearly. He can only be seen standing with his hands behind his back, facing a huge blood-colored moon.
"Wizards look up at the stars and see rules, truth, and paths."
The black figure raised his right hand and tapped it gently.
The blood moon suddenly shattered and turned into countless tiny points of light, dissipating in the night sky.
The picture changes again.
A bustling city appeared in the light curtain, with people coming and going on the streets, children chasing and playing, and vendors shouting.
"Mortals living on the surface of the world see three meals a day, birth, old age, sickness and death, joys and sorrows."
The perspective rises, beyond the city wall, across the fields, across the forest, and finally stops in front of a tall tower.
The tall tower was pitch black, with countless runes flowing on its surface, and a group of green flames suspended at the top.
"Wizards live deep in the world and see the flow of energy, the interweaving of rules, and the fragments of truth."
The scene cuts to the interior of the tower.
A man in a gray robe sat in the laboratory. There were bottles and jars in front of him. Liquids of various colors were rolling, boiling, and changing color in the glass vessels.
He held a slender glass rod in his hand, gently stirring a certain mass of shimmering liquid, his expression almost focused on obsession.
"What is a wizard?"
The voice paused for a moment.
"Wizards are explorers. Explore the essence of the world, explore the laws of energy, and explore the boundaries of rules."
The man in gray robe in the picture put down the glass rod, picked up a test tube filled with silver liquid, and carefully poured it into the beaker in front of him.
